description: This file defines the LayoutBuilderEntityViewDisplayForm class, which extends EntityViewDisplayEditForm to provide a form interface for editing layout display entities in Drupal's layout builder module. It includes methods for building and processing the form, handling layout options, and checking for overrides.

classes.name: LayoutBuilderEntityViewDisplayForm
classes.description: A form class for editing layout display entities within Drupal's layout builder module, providing UI for layout options and overrides.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds the form, setting the section storage and calling parent buildForm.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Defines the form elements, including layout options, manage layout link, and override controls based on entity state.

methods.name: isCanonicalMode
methods.description: Checks if the given mode is the canonical view mode, considering default and custom modes.

methods.name: hasOverrides
methods.description: Determines if the display has any layout overrides.

methods.name: copyFormValuesToEntity
methods.description: Copies form values to the entity, handling layout builder enablement.

methods.name: entityFormEntityBuild
methods.description: Builds layout-related form elements for the entity, enabling or disabling layout builder.

methods.name: buildFieldRow
methods.description: Builds form row for a field, skipping if layout builder is enabled.

methods.name: buildExtraFieldRow
methods.description: Builds extra form row for a field, skipping if layout builder is enabled.
